interface.longDescription: Reframe an attached MP4/MOV up to ten seconds and 50 MB into vertical, square or portrait formats. Choose center crop or padding; optional AI extension supports vertical and square. Watch and download the result inline. Crop can remove edge content; AI extension may alter details or audio. Start using the tools without Firemoon account linking. An existing Firemoon account can optionally be connected to use its current entitlements.
defaultPrompt: Make this clip vertical using a center crop.
Fit this whole video into a vertical frame with padding.
